_notes.usage: Copy the fields you need into config/floofclaw_config.json; keys beginning with an underscore are explanatory and ignored by the runtime.
_notes.bot_name: The bot's user-facing name and gateway process label.
_notes.default_floop: The floop used when a command does not pass --floop.

_notes.host: Local bind address for the gateway WebSocket listener.

_notes.cross_context_read: When true, agents may see active affairs from other conversation contexts.

_notes.what: Housekeeping cadences and retention counts for the gateway janitor module. The whole block is optional; every task has a safe default and an absent block means the defaults below are already in effect.
_notes.disabling: check_interval_ms: 0 or keep: 0 disables that one task.
_notes.runs: workspace/runs/<run_id>/ — a run directory is removed only when its persisted status is terminal; a running or waiting run is never touched, however old.
_notes.worker_stores: codex_ops, claude_ops, and hermes_ops each hold one entry per managed-worker operation under workspace/logs/. Count-only retention keeps the newest `keep` entries, except that an operation still running in workspace/memory/state/operations.json is never removed.
_notes.bus_processed: workspace/bus/processed/ — envelopes already consumed by intake.
_notes.logs: JSONL rotation. check_interval_ms is one cadence for every target; per-target max_size_bytes, keep, and compress ("gzip" or "none") live under targets.<name>. Targets: bus, deliveries, narration, llm_usage, rejected_events, gateway.

_force_disable_notes.what: Action ids this deployment refuses to run. Masked actions stay registered — floop allowlists keep declaring intent and still validate — but they are omitted from every agent catalog and rejected at dispatch.
_force_disable_notes.why_shipped_populated: Each listed action needs operator setup before it can work (a built helper, credentials, or an installed CLI). Complete the setup, then delete the id from this list to enable it. See each action's SETUP_<NAME>.md or README under actions/common/.
_force_disable_notes.entries: Ids only (action.json id), never directory names. Unknown ids are inert, so one list travels across deployment branches.

manage_codex._allowed_project_root_note: Optional absolute existing directory. Only calls with root=project use it; workspace remains the default.
manage_codex._max_permission_mode_note: Deployment ceiling for model-selected worker permissions. Keep safe unless this worker is explicitly trusted to bypass sandboxing and approvals.

manage_claude._max_permission_mode_note: Deployment ceiling for model-selected worker permissions. Keep safe unless this worker is explicitly trusted to bypass permission checks.

_notes.enabled: Expose the authenticated loopback local-client listener: GET /v1/health, /v1/pulse, /v1/usage and the chat upgrade.
_notes.path: HTTP path used for the FloofClawWS 1.0 upgrade. Provision its token with: fclaw auth set-stdin local_client_api.

_notes.enabled: Connect the IRC adapter when the gateway starts.
_notes.server: IRC server hostname; irc.libera.chat is a public example.
_notes.port: Use 6697 for TLS or 6667 for plaintext unless the network documents another port.
_notes.tls: Encrypt the IRC connection. TLS requires OpenSSL support in the build.
_notes.realname: IRC real-name field shown by WHOIS.
_notes.require_mention_in_channel: When true, channel messages must mention the bot nick; direct messages are unaffected.
_notes.ops_channel: Default IRC destination for proactive messages.

_notes.enabled: Connect the Discord adapter when the gateway starts.
_notes.debug: Print additional Discord adapter diagnostics to stderr.
_notes.allow_bots: Accept messages authored by other bots. Leave false for normal installs.
_notes.allow_dms: Accept direct messages to the bot.
_notes.require_mention_in_guild: When true, guild messages must mention the bot.
_notes.guild_id: Discord server ID from Developer Mode.
_notes.allowed_channel_ids: Guild channel IDs the bot is allowed to read and answer in.
_notes.token_key: Auth-store key containing the Discord bot token; this is a key name, never the token itself.
_notes.home_channel_id: Destination for proactive messages; when absent, delivery falls back to allowed_channel_ids[0].

_notes.enabled: Connect the Telegram adapter when the gateway starts.
_notes.allow_dms: Accept private chats with the bot.
_notes.allow_bots: Accept messages authored by other bots. Leave false for normal installs.
_notes.allowed_chat_ids: Group and supergroup chat IDs the bot may read and answer in; group traffic is refused unless listed.
_notes.token_key: Auth-store key containing the BotFather token; this is a key name, never the token itself.
_notes.tls_verify: Verify the api.telegram.org certificate. Leave true.
